summary: Preview loaded and workspace/account creation worked. Full expense flow was blocked by the mobile FAB being hidden behind the bottom tab bar; direct API checks found the frontend sync payload is incompatible with FastAPI.

critical.issue: Frontend sends camelCase OutboxEvent/Transaction fields (entityType, entityId, createdAt, workspaceId, amountMinor, etc.), but the FastAPI contract requires snake_case. A payload matching the frontend returns 422; snake_case succeeds.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667 the FAB is positioned underneath/behind the absolute bottom tab bar. Tapping Add expense does not open the modal, so the primary expense flow cannot be completed on mobile.

integration_issues.issue: When an expense is eventually queued, FinanceProvider.sync posts the camelCase object directly to /api/sync; backend rejects it with 422 and the outbox remains pending.

action_items: Move the Add expense FAB above the bottom tab safe area or add sufficient ScrollView bottom inset and provide testIDs for interactive controls.
Serialize frontend outbox and transaction fields to the backend snake_case contract, or add explicit Pydantic aliases; retest sync end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceProvider.sync uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; this matches the current .env but not the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL naming convention, so environment configuration should be standardized.
Interactive controls in index.tsx have no testID attributes, reducing reliable mobile regression coverage.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ workspace/account and one TEST_ transaction during direct API contract verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use one browser session at 375x667. Clear localStorage once at the start. Workspace and account creation pass; expense modal cannot be reached because the FAB is behind the bottom tabs. API /api/ root, workspace, and account creation pass.
rca_of_issue: The FAB is rendered as the last child inside a ScrollView with marginTop but no bottom content inset, while the tab bar is absolute at bottom:0; on the short mobile viewport it is covered by the tabs. Sync serializes TypeScript camelCase objects without a translation layer, while FastAPI models declare snake_case fields.
